passages.text: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself and made a covenant with the commanders of hundreds—with Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was a priest in Judah.
In the seventh year, Jehoiada became strong and courageous.
Jehoiada made a covenant with the commanders of hundreds.
Azariah was the son of Jeroham.
Ishmael was the son of Jehohanan.
Azariah was also the son of Obed.
Maaseiah was the son of Adaiah.
Elishaphat was the son of Zichri.
Jehoiada included these men with him in the covenant.
passages.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֨ה הַשְּׁבִעִ֜ית הִתְחַזַּ֣ק יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת לַעֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ יְרֹחָ֡ם וּלְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־ יְ֠הוֹחָנָן וְלַֽעֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ עוֹבֵ֜ד וְאֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ עֲדָיָ֛הוּ וְאֶת־ אֱלִישָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֖י עִמּ֥וֹ בַבְּרִֽית׃

passages.text: So they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the families of Israel. And when they came to Jerusalem, the whole assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. “Behold, the king’s son!” said Jehoiada. “He must reign, just as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was a priest in Judah.
He acted during the reign of Athaliah.
Jehoiada and his allies traveled throughout Judah.
They gathered the Levites from every city in Judah.
They also gathered the heads of the families of Israel.
All these leaders came to Jerusalem.
The whole assembly met in the house of God.
There, they made a covenant with the king.
Jehoiada spoke to the people.
He said, “Here is the king’s son.”
He said, “He must reign.”
He said, “The LORD promised this about the descendants of David.”
passages.original: וַיָּסֹ֙בּוּ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּקְבְּצ֤וּ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְרָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֥ל בְּרִ֛ית בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִם־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֶן־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י דָוִֽיד׃

passages.text: This is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who come on duty on the Sabbath shall keep watch at the doors, a third shall be at the royal palace, and a third at the Foundation Gate, while all the others are in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
He gave instructions to the priests and Levites.
Some priests and Levites came on duty on the Sabbath.
A third of these priests and Levites must guard the doors.
A third must be at the royal palace.
A third must be at the Foundation Gate.
All the other people must stay in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.
passages.original: זֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֨ית מִכֶּ֜ם בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת לַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְלַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְשֹֽׁעֲרֵ֖י הַסִּפִּֽים׃ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַיְס֑וֹד וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם בְּחַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: No one is to enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the people are to obey the requirement of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Only priests may enter the house of the LORD.
Only Levites who serve may enter the house of the LORD.
These priests and Levites are consecrated.
All other people must not enter the house of the LORD.
All the people must obey the command of the LORD.
passages.original: וְאַל־ יָב֣וֹא בֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י אִם־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַמְשָׁרְתִ֣ים לַלְוִיִּ֔ם הֵ֥מָּה יָבֹ֖אוּ כִּי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑מָּה וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם יִשְׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who enters the temple must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites must stand around the king.
Each Levite must hold his weapon in his hand.
Anyone who enters the temple must be put to death.
The Levites must stay with the king when he enters.
The Levites must stay with the king when he leaves.
passages.original: וְהִקִּיפוּ֩ הַלְוִיִּ֨ם אֶת־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־ הַבַּ֖יִת יוּמָ֑ת וִֽהְי֥וּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּבֹא֥וֹ וּבְצֵאתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the Levites and all Judah did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each of them took his men—those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.
passages.sermon:
The Levites obeyed Jehoiada the priest.
All Judah obeyed Jehoiada the priest.
Jehoiada the priest gave orders.
The Levites and all Judah did everything Jehoiada commanded.
Each leader took his men.
Some men were coming on duty for the Sabbath.
Some men were going off duty from the Sabbath.
Jehoiada the priest did not release any of the divisions.
All the divisions stayed on duty.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יוֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת כִּ֣י לֹ֥א פָטַ֛ר יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ הַֽמַּחְלְקֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then Jehoiada the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and the large and small shields of King David that were in the house of God.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
He gave weapons to the commanders of hundreds.
He gave them spears.
He gave them large shields.
He gave them small shields.
These weapons belonged to King David.
These weapons were kept in the house of God.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֗וֹת אֶת־ הַֽחֲנִיתִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַמָּגִנּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: He stationed all the troops, with their weapons in hand, surrounding the king by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
He led the people of Judah and the Levites.
Jehoiada stationed all the people.
Each man held his weapon in his hand.
They stood from the south side of the temple to the north side.
They stood by the altar and the temple.
They surrounded the king.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֜ם וְאִ֣ישׁ׀ שִׁלְח֣וֹ בְיָד֗וֹ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ עַד־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת עַל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Then Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, presented him with the Testimony, and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, “Long live the king!”
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
Jehoiada had sons.
Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son.
They put the crown on the king’s son.
They gave him the Testimony.
They made him king.
Jehoiada and his sons anointed him.
They said, “Long live the king!”
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּ֙זֶר֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֙הוּ֙ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע וּבָנָ֔יו וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

passages.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went out to them in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the queen.
She heard a loud noise.
The people were running.
The people were cheering for the king.
Athaliah went to the people.
She entered the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֗הוּ אֶת־ ק֤וֹל הָעָם֙ הָֽרָצִ֔ים וְהַֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And she looked out and saw the king standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, while the singers with musical instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, “Treason, treason!”
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the queen.
She looked out.
She saw the king.
The king stood by his pillar at the entrance.
The officers stood beside the king.
The trumpeters stood beside the king.
All the people of the land rejoiced.
The people blew trumpets.
The singers played musical instruments.
The singers led the people in praise.
Athaliah tore her clothes.
Athaliah shouted, “Treason! Treason!”
passages.original: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עוֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ עַמּוּד֜וֹ בַּמָּב֗וֹא וְהַשָּׂרִ֣ים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת֮ עַל־ הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְכָל־ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ שָׂמֵ֗חַ וְתוֹקֵ֙עַ֙ בַּחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת וְהַמְשֽׁוֹרֲרִים֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י הַשִּׁ֔יר וּמוֹדִיעִ֖ים לְהַלֵּ֑ל וַתִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס

passages.text: And Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army, saying, “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the priest.
He called the commanders of hundreds.
These commanders led the army.
Jehoiada spoke to them.
He said, “Take Athaliah out between the ranks.”
He said, “Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.”
Jehoiada had said, “Do not kill her in the house of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵא֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּא֣וֹת׀ פְּקוּדֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ הֽוֹצִיא֙וּהָ֙ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֣ית הַשְּׂדֵר֔וֹת וְהַבָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ יוּמַ֣ת בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֥א תְמִית֖וּהָ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate to the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.
passages.sermon:
The people seized Athaliah.
Athaliah reached the entrance of the Horse Gate.
The Horse Gate was at the palace grounds.
They put Athaliah to death there.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ לָהּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַתָּב֛וֹא אֶל־ מְב֥וֹא שַֽׁעַר־ הַסּוּסִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְמִית֖וּהָ שָֽׁם׃פ

passages.text: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and the king and the people that they would be the LORD’s people.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
Jehoiada made a covenant.
He made this covenant with the king.
He made this covenant with all the people.
The covenant said they would be the LORD’s people.
passages.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת יְהוֹיָדָע֙ בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֥ין כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וּבֵ֣ין הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So all the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
passages.sermon:
All the people gathered together.
They went to the temple of Baal.
They tore down the temple of Baal.
They broke the altars of Baal.
They smashed the idols of Baal.
They killed Mattan.
Mattan was the priest of Baal.
They killed him in front of the altars.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ כָל־ הָעָ֤ם בֵּית־ הַבַּ֙עַל֙ וַֽיִּתְּצֻ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתָ֥יו וְאֶת־ צְלָמָ֖יו שִׁבֵּ֑רוּ וְאֵ֗ת מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַבַּ֔עַל הָרְג֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַֽמִּזְבְּחֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Moreover, Jehoiada put the oversight of the house of the LORD into the hands of the Levitical priests, whom David had appointed over the house of the LORD, to offer burnt offerings to the LORD as is written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and song, as ordained by David.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
He gave responsibility for the house of the LORD to the Levitical priests.
David had appointed these priests over the house of the LORD.
The priests were to offer burnt offerings to the LORD.
They did this as it is written in the Law of Moses.
They offered the sacrifices with rejoicing.
They also sang songs.
David had commanded them to do this.
passages.original: וַיָּשֶׂם֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע פְּקֻדֹּ֜ת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּיַ֨ד הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָלַ֣ק דָּוִיד֮ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָה֒ לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת עֹל֣וֹת יְהוָ֗ה כַּכָּת֛וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה וּבְשִׁ֑יר עַ֖ל יְדֵ֥י דָוִֽיד׃

passages.text: He stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the LORD, so that nothing unclean could enter for any reason.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
He gave orders for the house of the LORD.
He placed gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the LORD.
The gatekeepers stood at every entrance.
They stopped anything unclean from entering.
No unclean person or thing could enter for any reason.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֵד֙ הַשּׁ֣וֹעֲרִ֔ים עַֽל־ שַׁעֲרֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ יָבֹ֥א טָמֵ֖א לְכָל־ דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: He also took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace through the Upper Gate. They seated King Joash on the royal throne, and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest.
He took the commanders of hundreds.
He took the nobles.
He took the rulers of the people.
He took all the people of the land.
They brought King Joash down from the house of the LORD.
They entered the royal palace through the Upper Gate.
They seated King Joash on the royal throne.
All the people of the land rejoiced.
The city was quiet.
They had put Athaliah to death by the sword.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת וְאֶת־ הָֽאַדִּירִים֩ וְאֶת־ הַמּֽוֹשְׁלִ֨ים בָּעָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֗רֶץ וַיּ֤וֹרֶד אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֛אוּ בְּתֽוֹךְ־ שַׁ֥עַר הָֽעֶלְי֖וֹן בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיּוֹשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א הַמַּמְלָכָֽה׃ וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כָל־ עַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהָעִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְאֶת־ עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בֶחָֽרֶב׃ס
